from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
root = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-gumroad-fit')
records = []
for path in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
    if not path.is_file() or 'raw' in path.relative_to(root).parts or path.suffix not in {'.py','.json','.md','.txt'} or path.stat().st_size > 60000:
        continue
    text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
    terms = ('license','licence','copyright','provenance','redistribut','attribution','original','third-party','third party','80b451146e7cdf45')
    hits = [{'line':i,'excerpt':line.strip()[:240]} for i,line in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1) if any(word in line.lower() for word in terms)]
    records.append({'path':str(path),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'candidate_passages':hits[:12]})
assert records, 'No matching committed artifacts in the selected directory'
output = root/'director-rights-evidence-index.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'Evidence pointers for invoice-regression.py and invoice-fixtures.json. Source claims require verification. This index does not establish redistribution or cohort rights.','records':records},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'artifact':str(output),'files_examined':len(records),'files_with_candidate_passages':sum(bool(r['candidate_passages']) for r in records)}))
